That was the message Gabriel Hughes received during a mound visit in the fourth inning of his 25th birthday start.

videos.summary_source_text:
On Star Wars Night, the Rockies came one run short of bringing balance back to Coors Field On Star Wars Night, the Rockies came one run short of bringing balance back to Coors Field.

Colorado fell 4-3 to Cleveland for its eighth straight home loss, but Warren Schaeffer saw real progress from Gabriel Hughes on his 25th birthday.

Hughes cruised through three scoreless innings on only 31 pitches before Jo Adell’s 450-foot three-run homer changed the game in the fourth. He responded with a 1-2-3 fifth and finished with three runs allowed over five innings.

videos.title: Jake Burger Opens Up About His Daughter, Down Syndrome & Rangers' Support
videos.summary_source_text:
Jake Burger Opens Up About His Daughter, Down Syndrome & Rangers' Support Texas Rangers first baseman Jake Burger sits down with Abby Jones for a powerful conversation about family, Players Weekend and the mission behind his foundation.

Burger discusses the special meaning behind his Players Weekend gear, which honors his daughter Penelope — affectionately known as Poppy — and the work his family is doing to raise awareness for Down syndrome.

He also opens up about the incredible support he's received from the Texas Rangers and his teammates, including the support they showed his family around Penelope's heart surgery.

Burger explains why being able to use his platform for something bigger than baseball means so much to him — and why he hopes people see the person before the baseball player. videos.title: Wyndham Clark stays HOT with 65 to lead by 5 | Round 3 | BMW Championship
videos.summary_source_text:
Wyndham Clark stays HOT with 65 to lead by 5 | Round 3 | BMW Championship In third round of the 2026 BMW Championship, Wyndham Clark followed up a pair of 64s with a 5-under 65 to get to 17-under after 54 holes, taking a five-shot lead into Sunday.

The BMW Championship, the second leg of the FedExCup Playoffs, heads to Bellerive Country Club near St. Louis, MO this week, hosting golf's top 50 for the first time since 2008. Scottie Scheffler enters as defending champion and the hottest player in the field, having just won the FedEx St. Jude Championship by eight shots to build a nearly 1,400-point lead atop the FedExCup standings. He'll try to become the first repeat BMW champion since Patrick Cantlay in 2021-22. Rory McIlroy looks to bounce back after a rough finish in Memphis, while Justin Rose, Rickie Fowler, and others are jockeying for position near the cut lines that determine who advances to the season-ending Tour Championship. Bellerive, a long Robert Trent Jones design that also hosted the 2018 PGA Championship, is expected to test the field with its tough closing stretch known as "The Ridge." Only the top 30 in points after this event will move on to East Lake for the FedExCup finale.

videos.title: The Healing Power of Lemon — Fight Inflammation and Protect Your Body | Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
The Healing Power of Lemon — Fight Inflammation and Protect Your Body | Dr. Mandell Discover the healing power of lemon and what this simple citrus fruit may be doing inside your body. Lemons provide vitamin C, citric acid, flavonoids, limonoids, and other powerful plant compounds that have been studied for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. In this video, Dr. Alan Mandell explains how lemon water can support hydration, digestion, healthy circulation, immune function, collagen production, and your body's natural defenses against oxidative stress. You'll also discover why citrate from lemon is especially interesting for kidney health and calcium stone prevention, how citrus compounds may influence inflammatory pathways, and why replacing sugary drinks with refreshing lemon water can be a simple addition to a healthier lifestyle. Lemon is not a cure for disease, but research continues to uncover fascinating ways its nutrients and bioactive compounds may support the body's normal protective and metabolic processes. Make this valuable information part of your healthy lifestyle and please share it with your friends and family.

PubMed Research:

“Can Lemon Juice Be an Alternative to Potassium Citrate in the Treatment of Urinary Calcium Stones in Patients With Hypocitraturia?” — A randomized clinical study found that fresh lemon juice significantly increased urinary citrate, an important factor in reducing calcium stone formation.

“Features, Pharmacological Chemistry, Molecular Mechanism and Health Benefits of Lemon” — A scientific review of Citrus limon discusses its bioactive compounds and reported antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, metabolic and organ-protective properties, while noting that evidence varies by outcome and study type.

“Citrus limon (Lemon) Phenomenon” — This review describes lemon's flavonoids, phenolic compounds and other bioactive constituents and summarizes research into antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity.

“Effects of Citrus Fruit Juices and Their Bioactive Components on Inflammation and Immunity” — This PubMed-indexed review describes how vitamin C and citrus polyphenols interact with oxidative stress, inflammatory pathways and immune function; much of the human juice evidence reviewed was from orange juice rather than lemon specifically.

“Limonoids With Anti-Inflammatory Activity: A Review” — Research examining limonoids found in citrus and related plants describes anti-inflammatory activity involving inflammatory mediators and cytokine pathways, primarily from experimental studies.

videos.title: 2 Golf Swing Release Positions for More Distance
videos.summary_source_text:
2 Golf Swing Release Positions for More Distance Want more clubhead speed and distance without just trying to swing harder? Pay attention to these two positions in your golf swing. ⛳️

Position 1: Maintain the lag in your downswing.
When the club reaches roughly parallel to the ground, you don’t want the clubhead to have already thrown past your hands.
If you release that angle too early, you’re essentially spending your speed before you get to the golf ball.
Instead, work on moving pressure toward the target while maintaining that wrist angle and lag deeper into the downswing.

Position 2: Let the club release through impact.
Creating lag doesn’t mean holding the club back forever.
Once you reach the strike, the club needs to release and continue moving through the ball.

That’s the sequence:
Create the lag → maintain it longer → release it through impact.
The goal isn’t to freeze your golf swing into a position. It’s to train the sequence so the club can build and release speed at the right time.

And if you struggle to actually feel that lag position, that’s exactly what the SLR3 Bumblebee is designed to help you practice. 🐝

Once You Understand This Concept, The Golf Swing Becomes Effortless You fix your slice. It comes back. You start striking your irons better, then a week later you’re hitting them fat again.

If you’ve tried golf swing tips to hit your driver straighter, improve your iron strike or stop coming over the top, but the changes never seem to last, this golf lesson is for you.

After working with some of the best players in the game, I noticed they do something very differently that helps them improve their golf swing faster, make changes that stick and take those improvements onto the golf course with far fewer swing thoughts.

Over the years I’ve worked with golfers of all levels, from complete beginners to elite players, and one of the biggest differences I’ve noticed isn’t how much they practise — it’s how they learn.

In this lesson, I’ll show you a simple practice habit you can use for just five minutes that can help you improve your swing path, strike your irons more solidly, reduce your slice and build a golf swing that feels far more natural on the course.

videos.summary_source_text:
Gunther Werks F-26 vs Lamborghini Revuelto: DRAG RACE Can a carbon fibre 911 993 with over 1,000hp take down a Lambo?

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-2208

We’ve got our hands on the Gunther Werks F26, and we’re putting it up against some incredible supercars! 

The Gunther Werks F26 is based on a Porsche 993, and it’s powered by a 4-litre twin-turbo flat-six that delivers an incredible 1,067hp and 1,017Nm! This power is sent to the rear wheels only via a 6-speed manual, and its carbon-fibre body means it weighs just 1,347kg! It’s limited to just 26 units worldwide, so it costs £1,200,000! 

So, given we’ve got our hands on such a rare car, we wanted to put it up against some supercar royalty, starting with the Porsche 911 GT3 RS. 

The GT3 RS is equipped with a 4-litre NA flat-six, and this creates 525hp and 465Nm. Power is sent to the rear via a 7-speed dual-clutch, and it tips the scales at 1,450kg. 

Should the Gunther Werks defeat the GT3 RS, we’ll bring in a Huracán Performante. This comes with a 5.2-litre naturally aspirated V10, and it puts down 640hp and 600Nm. However, unlike the F26, it comes with all-wheel drive! It’s still heavier, mind, coming in at 1,482kg. 

Should the F26 beat the Huracan, we have another contender waiting in the wings… But you’ll need to keep watching to see what it is! 

The question is, do you think the Gunther Werks F26 is worth the £1.2m price tag? Let us know in the comments!

videos.summary_source_text:
Even Country Music Stars Have Time To Perfect Their Golf Game | Closed Course w/ Dylan Marlowe Welcome back to another episode of ‘Closed Course’ 

The guys are back for another great episode with an awesome guest interview. Rising country music star Dylan Marlowe joins the show to talk about his quickly progressing career in music, life at home with newborn twins, and most importantly, his love for playing as much golf as he can in his free time. 

Dylan Marlowe is quickly catching tons of traction in the country music scene. From going on tour to support Ella Langley and playing country music festivals, to headlining his own tours across the country, his style of music is gaining more fans faster than we can keep track.

Dylan and the hosts discuss how he got into playing music, what his goals are for performing and releasing new records, and what to expect for his next headline tour, which will be announced very soon!Dylan also talks about his increased love for playing golf, as much as he can. Wherever in the world he’s stopping in for a show, he almost certainly will fit in a round at a local course in the area. Whether it’s Bandon Dunes in Oregon, Pinehurst in North Carolina, or Arrowhead Golf Course, right here in Colorado, he’s had the chance to plays tons of awesome courses while touring around the world. And it’s not just playing the courses…Dylan is meticulous about growing his skills and improving his game. Currently sitting at around an 11 handicap, he’s already broken 80 and is on his way to being one of the best golfers in the country music scene.

Tune into the latest episode of ‘Closed Course’ to hear great country music stories, golf tips, and life advice from Dylan Marlowe! 

You can find Dylan on Instagram and TikTok @dylanmarlowemusic and on X @_dylanmarlowe

Dylan’s music can be found on Apple Music, Spotify, or wherever you find your music by searching ‘Dylan Marlowe’

videos.title: 21.08.26 - RIFT Education Day
videos.summary_source_text:
21.08.26 - RIFT Education Day RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

videos.title: How to Shallow the Golf Club Like the Pros
videos.summary_source_text:
How to Shallow the Golf Club Like the Pros How to Shallow the Golf Club Like the Pros

Trying to shallow the golf club in your downswing? Don’t make the mistake of trying to force the club shallow with your hands. 👀⛳️

A better place to start is your backswing position.
If your hands and arms don’t have enough room at the top, it becomes much harder for the club to reroute and work from the inside during the downswing.

Instead, look at:
→ Getting enough rotation in the backswing
→ Allowing your hands to work deeper
→ Creating space with your arm and elbow position
→ Giving the club room to shallow naturally in transition

The goal isn’t to manufacture a shallow golf swing.
It’s to build a backswing and golf swing sequence that gives the club somewhere to go.
More room going back = a much better opportunity to approach the golf ball from the inside coming down.

And remember: getting the club shallow is only useful if you can turn that delivery into better contact.

The BMW Championship, the second leg of the FedExCup Playoffs, heads to Bellerive Country Club near St. Louis, MO this week, hosting golf's top 50 for the first time since 2008. Scottie Scheffler enters as defending champion and the hottest player in the field, having just won the FedEx St. Jude Championship by eight shots to build a nearly 1,400-point lead atop the FedExCup standings. He'll try to become the first repeat BMW champion since Patrick Cantlay in 2021-22. Rory McIlroy looks to bounce back after a rough finish in Memphis, while Justin Rose, Rickie Fowler, and others are jockeying for position near the cut lines that determine who advances to the season-ending Tour Championship. Bellerive, a long Robert Trent Jones design that also hosted the 2018 PGA Championship, is expected to test the field with its tough closing stretch known as "The Ridge." Only the top 30 in points after this event will move on to East Lake for the FedExCup finale.

videos.summary_source_text:
OpenAI and Google Just Changed Cybersecurity Forever https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
OpenAI and Google just made two very different bets on the future of AI cybersecurity.

OpenAI's GPT-5.6-Cyber goes deep: a highly capable cybersecurity model designed to find, understand, and help exploit software vulnerabilities — but access is tightly restricted.

videos.summary_source_text:
Heal Neuropathy, Nerve Pain & Inflammation | Dr. Mandell Burning feet, tingling hands, numbness, stabbing pain, and electric-shock sensations can be signs that your nerves are irritated, damaged, or struggling to function normally. In this video, I share 9 powerful ways to help support neuropathy, nerve pain, and inflammation by addressing factors that can affect the health of the nerve itself. You’ll learn how stabilizing blood sugar, reducing oxidative stress and chronic inflammation, supporting mitochondrial energy production, getting adequate magnesium and important B vitamins such as B1 and B12, and nutrients including alpha-lipoic acid, CoQ10, omega-3 fatty acids, and curcumin may support healthier nerve function. I’ll also explain why regular movement, quality sleep, breathing, and stress reduction can play an important role in calming overly sensitive nerves and supporting cellular repair. Your nerves require tremendous amounts of energy to maintain normal electrical signaling, and when mitochondrial function and ATP production are impaired, nerves may become more irritable and hyperexcitable. The goal is not simply to cover up burning and tingling, but to understand and address factors that may be contributing to unhealthy nerve function. Neuropathy has many possible causes, including diabetes, vitamin deficiencies, medications, chemotherapy, nerve compression, and other medical conditions, so persistent or worsening numbness, burning, tingling, weakness, or pain should always be evaluated by a qualified healthcare professional. Always speak with your healthcare professional before starting supplements or making significant changes to your health regimen. Scientific References: Ziegler D, et al. Round 2 Highlights | 2026 Nexo Championship Second round highlights of the 2026 Nexo Championship at Trump International Golf Links. Highlights include Patrick Reed, Grant Forrest and Matt Jordan.

► SUBSCRIBE: http://et.golf/Subscribe 

The closing swing returns to where it started, Scotland. The winner of the closing swing will earn a spot in all Back 9 tournaments and receive a bonus. After a successful inaugural year under Nexo’s title sponsorship, the championship returns to the Old Course at Trump International Golf Links. In windy conditions, the true challenge of links golf is at its most apparent and that is expected to be the case again this week, so every opportunity needs to be capitalised on. After this week, there are just 11 events scheduled to take place before the Race to Dubai champion is crowned. Patrick Reed who is teeing it up this weekend is currently in line to take the crown for the first time. Also teeing it up this weekend chasing Patrick Reed in the Race to Dubai rankings is Eugenio Chacarra and Casey Jarvis, along with John Daly II, who is making his professional debut on the DP World Tour. For the first time this year there will be a Celebrity Pro-Am featuring some of the biggest Scottish sporting stars from Tennis, Rugby and Football such as Andy Murray, Kyle Steyn and James McArthur. 

Welcome to the Official YouTube channel of the DP World Tour. Every week you can find extended tournament highlights and individual player highlights from the likes of Rory McIlroy, Justin Rose and Tommy Fleetwood. This is also the home of the 14 Club Challenge, Little Interviews, Fastest Hole and many more challenges, pranks and world record attempts featuring the biggest golfers in the world.

videos.summary_source_text:
GPT-5.6 Is 14× Faster… But There’s a BIG Problem https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
OpenAI's GPT-5.6 is here — with up to 750 tokens per second, an 88.8% agentic coding score, a 1 MILLION-token context window, and new AI agents designed to do real work for you.

But is GPT-5.6 actually the smartest AI model yet — or is the biggest story hiding somewhere else?

In this video, I break down GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna, ChatGPT Work, Codex, OpenAI's new agent capabilities, benchmark results, pricing, and the new Ultrafast mode. We also compare GPT-5.6 against Claude, Gemini and Grok to see where OpenAI is really ahead — and where the competition still wins.

Some of the numbers are huge:

• Up to 750 output tokens/second
• Roughly 14× faster in Ultrafast mode
• 88.8% on Terminal-Bench 2.1
• 52.7 on Agents' Last Exam
• 1 MILLION tokens of context
• Around 1/3 the cost per task of Claude in one independent analysis
• Yet only around 7.8% on ARC-AGI

And there's a bigger question: can ChatGPT Work actually operate like an autonomous AI coworker, or do these agents still need a human checking everything they produce?

We dig into the benchmarks, the speed claims, hallucinations, autonomous AI agents, Codex, and what GPT-5.6 means for the AI race between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and xAI.

videos.title: How to Compress Your Irons: Right Elbow + Pressure Shift
videos.summary_source_text:
How to Compress Your Irons: Right Elbow + Pressure Shift Want to compress your irons and create better ball-first contact? Your right elbow at impact might be telling you what’s going wrong. 👀⛳️

A lot of golfers try to force the right elbow down in the downswing—but if your pressure and body aren’t moving correctly first, there may not be enough room for the elbow to get into a strong impact position.

Instead, pay attention to the sequence:
→ Shift pressure toward the target
→ Give the right elbow room to work in front of the body
→ Keep the upper body from taking over too early
→ Arrive at impact in a better position to compress the golf ball

That pressure shift is a huge piece of creating a more consistent golf swing, low point, iron strike, and ball-first contact.

You don’t need to manufacture the perfect impact position with your arms. Train the movement that helps your body arrive there naturally.

And that’s exactly where the Ball First Board comes in. 👇

If you struggle with hanging back, inconsistent contact, or getting into the right position at impact, use the Ball First Board to train the pressure shift this video is teaching.
It gives you a physical way to practice moving pressure forward so you can build a more repeatable pattern for ball-first contact and compressed iron shots.

videos.title: Ska du köpa simulator? Missa inte detta…
videos.channel: Bättre & Enklare golf med Marcus Edblad PGA
videos.summary_source_text:
Ska du köpa simulator? Missa inte detta… Det är snart dags att tänka på vintergolf i simulator. Missa inte detta om du funderar på att köpa en ny simulator i år. Här kommer en presentation av GolfJoy som jag nu använt i ett år och är supernöjd med.

www.easygreen.se      www.golfstudiosweden.se.    www.rydbo360.se

#golf #golftips #golfswing 

0:00 Intro till att köpa ny simulator

Nu finns det möjlighet att genom appen Skillest göra mig till din personliga tränare. Du hittar mig på denna länk: https://skillest.com/app/profile/marcus-edblad

Låt mig hjälpa dig finna bättre slag, bollträff, riktning och svinghastighet. Oavsett om du slår en wedge, järnklubba eller driver kan du med dina händer lära dig golfslag som du inte trodde var möjliga. Längre och rakare slag kräver alltid träning men något alla kan lära sig.  

Vare sig du kämpar med en slice eller en hook så har jag videos som kan guida till bättre golf. Är du nybörjare så kan du börja med min grönt kort eller nybörjarkurs.

Försök ersätta dåliga vanor med nya bättre vanor. Oavsett vilket loft eller skaft din klubba har så är det du som bestämmer vad som ska hända. Oavsett om det står callaway, ping, titleist eller taylor made på klubban så kan du slå bra slag.

Var noga med vad du tittar på. Det finns många duktiga instruktörer på nätet, några av mina favoriter är Mike Malaska, Mike Dunaway, Mike Austin.

Försök fokusera på grunderna i slaget bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår. Träna med fördel på en sak i taget. Tränar du din svinghastighet måste du tillåta att det går snett och tränar du raka slag kan du inte samtidigt svinga i max fart.

Ha tålamod och låt det ta sin tid, luras inte av genvägar som bara gör att du tappar fokus från det viktiga. Golf kommer alltid vara svårt men vi kan med träning se till att vi blir bättre för varje dag som går.

Titta mycket på golf på TV. Bryson Dechambeu, Dustin Johnson, Rory Mcilroy kan inspirera till längre slag och andra som Tiger Woods, Viktor Hovland, Ludvig Åberg och Phil Mickelson kan ge dig fantasi att skapa nya slag.

😋 Better than Chocolate Eggs - Ice Cream in a Minute WITHOUT Sugar. Never Buy Them in the Store 😋 Better than Chocolate Eggs - Ice Cream in a Minute WITHOUT Sugar. Never buy them at the store - make them at home with healthy ingredients.

4.2 oz (120 g) sugar-free dark chocolate.
Melt the chocolate using any method you like.
Today we’re making a delicious and healthier homemade dessert.
We’ll use a Chocolate Egg container as our mold.
We’re throwing away all the sweet cream because it’s loaded with refined sugar.
1 cup (150 g) cashews. Soak in boiling water for 30 minutes. 1 cup (250 ml) milk of your choice. I used almond milk.
5 Medjool dates. Vanilla.
¼ cup (50 g) peanut butter.
Coat the inside of the mold with the first layer of chocolate and place in the freezer for 10 minutes.
This dessert is incredibly easy to make with just a few simple ingredients.
Coat the inside of the mold with the second layer of chocolate and place in the freezer for 10 minutes.
But then I ran into a little problem! 😅
The chocolate wouldn’t come out of the mold.
So these Chocolate Eggs aren’t just loaded with sugar—the containers aren’t very useful as molds either!
I won’t be buying them again.
From now on, I’ll use a silicone mold instead.
Coat the silicone mold with a layer of chocolate and place in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Place in the freezer for 2–3 hrs.

20.08.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

Fansbase Confidence in Avs Front Office Improves. Drafting and Developing Remains Biggest Obstacle Colorado Avalanche front office confidence surges as fan sentiment shifts—are the Avs building another Stanley Cup contender? Chris Micieli and Zach Pearson break down The Athletic’s front office report card, revealing a leap to 9th overall, but question whether drafting and prospect development are holding the team back. With key names like Nathan MacKinnon and Cale Makar anchoring the core, the conversation spotlights fan frustrations over missed opportunities and the need for more young talent.

The hosts tackle hot-button NHL topics, including league-wide fan polls on Gary Bettman’s legacy, the impact of income taxes on free agency, and whether expanded gambling threatens hockey's integrity. From Department of Player Safety controversies to bold proposals like shorthanded goal penalties and rethinking playoff seeding, every angle gets a candid, passionate look. Are the Avalanche primed for sustained dominance, or could critical weaknesses derail their ambitions?

Ron Chenoy-USA TODAY Sports

videos.summary_source_text:
PGA TOUR Highlights | Round 1 | BMW Championship | 2026 Check out all the best shots from the 2026 BMW Championship, featuring Rory McIlroy, Scottie Scheffler, Xander Schauffele, Gary Woodland and Matt Fitzpatrick, among others.

The BMW Championship, the second leg of the FedExCup Playoffs, heads to Bellerive Country Club near St. Louis, MO this week, hosting golf's top 50 for the first time since 2008. Scottie Scheffler enters as defending champion and the hottest player in the field, having just won the FedEx St. Jude Championship by eight shots to build a nearly 1,400-point lead atop the FedExCup standings. He'll try to become the first repeat BMW champion since Patrick Cantlay in 2021-22. Rory McIlroy looks to bounce back after a rough finish in Memphis, while Justin Rose, Rickie Fowler, and others are jockeying for position near the cut lines that determine who advances to the season-ending Tour Championship. Bellerive, a long Robert Trent Jones design that also hosted the 2018 PGA Championship, is expected to test the field with its tough closing stretch known as "The Ridge." Only the top 30 in points after this event will move on to East Lake for the FedExCup finale.

videos.title: How Should You Skate In A Tight Circle
videos.summary_source_text:
How Should You Skate In A Tight Circle The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

videos.title: Never Forget Someone’s Name Again — Do This When You Meet Them | Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
Never Forget Someone’s Name Again — Do This When You Meet Them | Dr. Mandell Have you ever met someone, heard their name clearly, and then seconds later realized it was completely gone? This happens to millions of people, and it doesn’t necessarily mean you have a bad memory. Names are unusually difficult for the brain to remember because, unlike a face, voice, object, or location, a name often has very little built-in meaning or visual information for the brain to grab onto. When you first hear a name, it enters working memory, where attention is limited and easily interrupted by everything else happening during a social interaction—making eye contact, thinking about what you’re going to say, listening to the other person, and being aware of how you are coming across. If that information isn’t properly encoded, the name may disappear before it ever becomes a stable memory. In this video, I explain how attention, working memory, the prefrontal cortex, and the hippocampus work together when you meet someone, and why stress, fatigue, poor sleep, distraction, and simply having too much going on at once can make remembering names even more difficult. More importantly, I’ll show you several simple ways to make a name more memorable the moment you hear it. Repeating the name once out loud can strengthen your attention to it. Connecting the name to a visual feature gives the brain another association to retrieve later. Adding a small physical movement, deliberately focusing your attention, and creating a meaningful association can provide additional cues for encoding and recall. Timing also matters—the first few seconds after hearing a name are important, so instead of trying desperately to remember it minutes later, give it your full attention immediately. Forgetting a newly introduced person’s name from time to time is common and is different from persistent or progressive memory problems involving familiar people, places, events, or everyday functioning. The goal is to work with the way your memory naturally operates: pay attention, create associations, repeat important information, and give your brain multiple ways to retrieve it later. Try these techniques the next time someone introduces themselves and see how much easier remembering their name can become. Please share this video with your friends and family, and most importantly, make it a day!  Dr. Mandell

videos.title: Elon Musk’s “Macrohard” Could Change Work Forever… If It Actually Works
videos.summary_source_text:
Elon Musk’s “Macrohard” Could Change Work Forever… If It Actually Works https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
Elon Musk’s Macrohard sounds almost impossible: an AI system designed to emulate the functions of an entire software company — potentially handling coding, customer support, spreadsheets, enterprise software and more through autonomous AI agents.

But how much of it is actually real?

In this video, I break down Elon Musk’s Macrohard AI project, the reported Tesla and xAI connection, the technology behind its computer-use agents, the money involved, and the surprisingly large gap between what has been promised and what has actually been demonstrated.

The idea is ambitious. Grok would act as the “brain,” planning complex tasks, while a Tesla-built computer-use agent would act as the “body” — watching a computer screen and operating software through the mouse and keyboard.

And unlike many AI agents that depend on integrations or APIs, the bigger vision is an AI worker capable of using software much more like a human does.

If it works, the implications could extend far beyond Tesla, xAI or Microsoft. It could affect enterprise software, SaaS pricing, customer support, software development and ultimately the way companies think about human work itself.

But there’s a major problem.

There still hasn’t been a public demonstration proving the full vision works — and reporting around the project raises questions about how quickly Musk’s ambitious plan can actually become reality.

So is Macrohard the beginning of the AI-run company?

Or is the hype moving much faster than the technology?

Watch the full breakdown before deciding.

videos.title: #TBT: Aho becomes 4th Finn with 10 straight 20+-goal seasons! 🇫🇮🚨
videos.summary_source_text:
#TBT: Aho becomes 4th Finn with 10 straight 20+-goal seasons! 🇫🇮🚨 Our next trip down memory lane for the 2025-26 NHL season brings us to February 3, 2026, as the Carolina Hurricanes host the Ottawa Senators at the Lenovo Center. videos.summary_source_text:
Make Your Golf Swing 10% Easier Want to make your golf swing feel 10% easier without losing distance? 👀⛳️
One of the biggest mistakes golfers make when trying to hit the ball farther is creating more effort with the arms and shoulders.

But your biggest source of power is lower down. 👇
A more efficient golf swing starts with:
→ Using the ground and your legs to generate force
→ Creating a proper horizontal weight shift
→ Sequencing the lower body before the upper body
→ Letting that energy transfer into clubhead speed

When your body works in the right order, you don’t have to feel like you’re swinging harder to create more speed. Better golf swing sequencing = more efficient power with less effort.
That’s exactly what the First Ball Board helps you learn. It gives you feedback you can actually feel so you can train the shift, pressure, and movement pattern instead of just trying to think your way through it.

If you’ve been trying to create more distance by swinging harder, try training the movement that creates the speed instead. 👇

videos.title: The Driver Comparison Test Some People WON'T Like
videos.summary_source_text:
The Driver Comparison Test Some People WON'T Like Let’s compare the Cobra OPTM X driver and Titleist GTS2 driver. In this Cobra OPTM X vs Titleist GTS2 driver review, Mark Crossfield puts two of the best golf drivers of 2026 head-to-head to compare performance, distance, forgiveness, ball speed, spin, technology and price.

The Cobra OPTM X and Titleist GTS2 both promise more speed, stability and forgiveness, but they use very different technology to achieve it, and there's also a significant difference in price. So which performs better, what are you actually getting for your money, and which one should you buy?

Mark tests both drivers using launch monitor data to compare ball speed, carry distance, spin rates and consistency, while also looking at appearance, sound, feel, adjustability and fitting options.

The Cobra OPTM X features Cobra's new POI (Product of Inertia) approach to stability alongside H.O.T. Face technology, adjustable weighting and the FutureFit33 hosel, giving golfers a huge range of fitting and shot-shape options.

The Titleist GTS2 uses Titleist's Split Mass Frame, Speed Sync face technology, adjustable weighting, improved aerodynamics and the established SureFit hosel to combine speed and stability in a driver designed to suit a wide range of golfers.
But how much difference does all of that technology actually make when both clubs are properly fitted to the same golfer?

With around £100 separating these two drivers, the comparison raises a bigger question about modern golf equipment: does spending more actually give you better performance? Or are fitting, looks, sound, feel and brand preference becoming increasingly important when choosing between modern drivers?

videos.title: 860hp V12 + MANUAL! Pagani is PEAK Hypercar
videos.summary_source_text:
860hp V12 + MANUAL! Pagani is PEAK Hypercar Is the Pagani Utopia Roadster the ultimate hypercar? 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-2008

Mat’s about to get his hands on a Pagani Utopia Roadster! 

He’s had his hands on a Pagani in a drag race before, but he’s never had the chance to get behind the wheel of one on the open road. However, that’s about to change! 

He’s over in Modena at the Pagani factory, and he’s about to see what it’s like to drive a €3,100,000 hypercar through the Italian hills! So let’s take a closer look at the car he’ll be driving… 

From the outside, this Pagani screams power and performance. Up front there’s an absolutely huge opening in the bumper to help cool the engine, and there are vents on either side of the wide wheel arches. The headlights also have a very distinct design, which is actually inspired by classic cars and Vespas from the 1960s! There’s also the single windscreen wiper, which is synonymous with Paganis. Around the back, the Utopia Roadster has incredible presence, with the ceramic-coated quad tailpipes sitting in the centre of the rear end. There’s also a large wing with active aero. But what’s most surprising is that a car with so much power has a completely flat bottom - no aggressive-looking diffuser to be found here! 

Step inside and the Pagani is incredibly well built. Any bit of metal you see is milled aluminium, and any area not covered in metal is likely lined in leather. There are analogue dials for the driver, and a small digital screen in-between each dial to manage the infotainment system. That means that the centre console and dash are completely bereft of screens, instead including more dials and a host of physical switches! 

The Pagani Utopia Roadster is powered by a 6-litre twin-turbo V12 that delivers 864hp and 1,100Nm of torque. It’s an AMG engine that revs to 6,500RPM, and the power is delivered to the rear wheels only via a 7-speed manual gearbox. In terms of weight, it tips the scales at only 1,280kg dry. 

So the Utopia Roadster starts from €3,100,000, but once you add several options, the price will skyrocket. So is it worth it? Or would you choose a Koenigsegg or Bugatti instead? Let us know in the comments! Is the Pagani Utopia Roadster the ultimate hypercar?

videos.title: Claude’s Text Watermark Could Follow It Everywhere
videos.summary_source_text:
Claude’s Text Watermark Could Follow It Everywhere Anthropic is working on a watermark for Claude-generated text that could follow the text even after you copy, paste, or edit it 👀

They haven't revealed exactly how this watermark works yet, but one way could be by creating a statistical pattern in Claude's word choices that humans can’t see, but a detector potentially could.

And the implications of this have taken the internet by storm. 


People are wondering what happens if Claude only edits something that you originally wrote? Does that now get flagged as AI-generated? What about code, copyright, privacy, or people simply rewriting the text enough to remove the watermark entirely?

And then there’s the bigger debate: Do people have a right to know when something was created with AI? 


Curious where you land on this one. Let me know in the comments 👇

And follow for more AI news and updates.

videos.title: 19.08.26 - Ep.22 (Part 2) - The Prop Trading Revolution: Why Win Rate Means Almost Nothing
videos.summary_source_text:
19.08.26 - Ep.22 (Part 2) - The Prop Trading Revolution: Why Win Rate Means Almost Nothing In this episode, we go deeper into professional trader evaluation and explore why one of the most commonly misunderstood trading metrics — win rate — tells us far less than many traders think.

A trader can have a very high win rate and still perform poorly if their losses are large enough. Conversely, a trader with a lower win rate can produce much stronger long-term results through disciplined risk management, controlled losses and favorable risk-to-reward.

We examine the difference between win rate and expectancy, and why professional institutions focus on the overall distribution and quality of returns rather than simply counting winning trades.

From there, we explore the key metrics used by hedge funds, prop firms and professional capital managers to evaluate traders and strategies, including:

Sharpe Ratio
Sortino Ratio
Maximum Drawdown
Profit Factor
Recovery Factor
Alpha and Beta
Volatility
Correlation
Position Concentration
Risk-adjusted performance

We also look at why capital preservation sits at the center of professional trading. Making money is only one part of the equation. The more important question is whether a trader can protect capital, control drawdowns and continue performing across changing market conditions.

Position Sizing: The Science of Survival

The episode also examines why position sizing can be more important than simply predicting market direction.

Professional capital managers use structured approaches to determine how much capital should be exposed to any individual opportunity. We introduce concepts such as:

Fixed position sizing
Volatility-based position sizing
Value at Risk
Kelly Criterion
Portfolio exposure limits

The objective is simple: no single trade should be capable of causing catastrophic damage to the portfolio.

This leads to a central principle of professional capital management:

The best trader is not necessarily the trader who generates the highest returns. It may be the trader who manages risk most effectively and consistently.

From One-Time Challenges to Continuous Evaluation

We then move into the next stage of the discussion: how artificial intelligence could change the way professional traders are evaluated.

Traditional prop trading generally uses a front-loaded evaluation model. A trader completes a challenge, reaches certain objectives, and may then receive access to capital.

But professional institutions operate differently. Portfolio managers are continuously monitored. Risk exposure changes. Position limits evolve. Capital allocation can increase or decrease depending on sustained performance.

AI creates the possibility of bringing this kind of continuous evaluation into future proprietary trading infrastructure.

Instead of simply asking:

"Did this trader make money?"

AI can examine:

"How did this trader make money?"

Every trade generates data — including execution, position size, holding period, market conditions, drawdown behavior, reactions to losses, consistency, rule adherence and risk management.

Over thousands of trades, this information can create a detailed behavioral and performance profile.

Dynamic Capital Scoring

The episode concludes by introducing Dynamic Capital Scoring.

Rather than permanently assigning the same amount of capital to every trader, future systems could continuously evaluate performance and adapt capital allocation accordingly.

For example:

Higher consistency → higher score → greater potential capital access

Declining discipline → lower score → reduced allocation

This creates a more adaptive model in which capital follows demonstrated performance and disciplined risk management.

We finish this session at Dynamic Capital Scoring and will continue into Autonomous Prop Trading Infrastructure in the next part.

Key themes: win rate vs expectancy, institutional trader evaluation, Sharpe Ratio, Sortino Ratio, drawdown, profit factor, recovery factor, position sizing, capital preservation, AI-powered evaluation, continuous trader assessment and dynamic capital allocation. In this video, we break down the key differences between hyperkalemia (too much potassium) and hypokalemia (too little potassium).

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/4bDua6X

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements.

Since about 98% of your body's potassium is stored inside your cells, blood tests only measure a small fraction, meaning symptoms are often subtle and easy to miss unless levels become extreme.

Understanding these signs can help you know when it's time to get your levels checked. Watch the full video to learn more about how potassium impacts your body and what factors can influence your levels.

videos.summary_source_text:
From Worst On Her Team To One Of California’s Top Players The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

videos.title: 1/2 Teaspoon Before Bed — Fall Asleep Faster, Sleep Deeper Tonight | Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
1/2 Teaspoon Before Bed — Fall Asleep Faster, Sleep Deeper Tonight | Dr. Mandell Many people struggle to fall asleep, stay asleep, or wake up feeling truly refreshed. This simple nighttime drink combines warm milk with nutmeg to create a soothing bedtime ritual that may help your body relax and prepare for a more restful night. Nutmeg contains naturally occurring plant compounds and antioxidants, while milk provides tryptophan, an amino acid involved in the body's production of serotonin and melatonin—important pathways involved in normal sleep. Research on milk and dairy products suggests potential benefits for sleep, although results vary and the effects may be modest.

INGREDIENTS: 1 cup whole milk, almond milk, or soy milk • ½ teaspoon ground nutmeg • Optional pinch of cinnamon • Optional small drizzle of honey.

HOW TO MAKE IT: Warm the milk until comfortably hot. Stir in ½ teaspoon of ground nutmeg and add a pinch of cinnamon if desired. Let it cool slightly, then add a little honey for sweetness if you like. Sip it slowly as part of your bedtime wind-down routine. The warmth, aroma, and relaxing nighttime ritual can help signal that it's time to settle down for sleep. Use only the recommended culinary amount of nutmeg—more is not better.

RESEARCH: Studies have examined the relationship between dairy foods, tryptophan and sleep. A systematic review of milk and dairy products found some evidence of improvements in aspects of sleep, although findings varied between studies. Research also supports the biological role of tryptophan as a precursor involved in serotonin and melatonin pathways, and studies of tryptophan supplementation have reported improvements in certain measures of sleep.

PubMed Research

• Nutmeg contains active compounds such as myristicin and elemicin shown to support calming neurological effects and reduce nervous system overactivity. PubMed PMID: 22998540
• Nutmeg demonstrates strong anti inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help relax tissues and reduce stress pathways before sleep. PubMed PMID: 24811878
• Warm milk provides natural tryptophan which converts to serotonin and melatonin for improved sleep regulation. PubMed PMID: 32629884
• Cinnamon has been shown to support blood sugar regulation and digestive comfort which can help settle the body before bedtime. PubMed PMID: 34809305
• Honey supports gut soothing effects and may assist with improved sleep quality through natural carbohydrate mediated melatonin support. PubMed PMID: 23764489

****************************************

If you’re still slicing, one of these 3 things is probably happening.

Your upper body starts the downswing first and throws your right shoulder out, your right hand takes over and sends the club over the top, or your right elbow gets on top instead of working underneath.

Try these 3 fixes:
1. Start the downswing with your lower body and let the club fall behind you.
2. Hit some left hand only swings to take the right hand out of it.
3. Feel your right elbow work underneath as you start down.

Relief Isn't the Same as Real Ease Relief matters—but temporary relief is not always the same as real ease.

Many people I speak with have tried stretching, massage, adjustments, exercises, treatments, and countless techniques. Something may help for a while, but eventually the familiar tension, bracing, or discomfort returns.

That does not mean the relief was unimportant. It may simply mean that something deeper has not changed yet.

Relief often means that a symptom has decreased.

Ease may feel like:

Less effort.
Less bracing.
A freer breath.
More support.
More movement options.
Less need to monitor and correct yourself.
A different relationship with your body.

Students in Moving Freely in Your Body often describe moments of flow, playfulness, whole-body connection, and movement that feels less controlled. That is different from simply making one body part feel looser.

In this video, I explain this distinction and guide you through a short reflection to help you recognize what genuine ease feels like for you.

videos.summary_source_text:
Lymphedema: What Doctors Don't Tell You (Diet Connection) What’s the difference between lymphedema and ordinary leg swelling? Discover the underlying causes of lymphedema, the connection between lymphedema and diet, and how supporting your metabolic health may help reduce chronic leg swelling and lymphedema symptoms.

0:00 Lymphedema diet connection 
0:12 Lymphatic drainage explained

7:43 More lymphedema solutions

👉 Download Dr. Berg’s Free Daily Health Routine: https://drbrg.co/4bWgcgy

Learn more about the underlying causes of leg swelling. Watch these next: 
▶️ https://youtu.be/TBSGhpG8yfE
▶️ https://youtu.be/uu3N_mSwJHw
▶️ https://youtu.be/0pEjjaaFaVs

Learn more about your lymphatic system in this article: https://drbrg.co/3U5LSdp

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements. 

Most people think lymphedema is trapped water, similar to edema, but it’s not that simple.
It’s a normal occurrence for protein and water to leak out of the blood vessels into the surrounding tissues. A healthy lymphatic system removes this excess fluid from the tissues and returns it to the bloodstream.

When the lymphatic system fails, protein can become trapped in the limbs. This trapped protein is what separates lymphedema from general leg swelling or edema. Lymphedema occurs when lymphatic drainage isn’t working properly, typically due to a blockage or inadequate pumping of the lymphatic system.

Lymphedema is often worse in one leg than the other, while edema involves more equal swelling on both sides. Diuretics aren’t typically effective for lymphedema because they remove water but not the trapped protein.

To address chronic leg swelling and lymphedema symptoms, it’s important to understand what’s interfering with the lymphatic system’s ability to pump and drain properly. Metabolic health is often linked to the severity of lymphedema.

Most people think lymphedema is trapped water, similar to edema, but it’s not that simple.
It’s a normal occurrence for protein and water to leak out of the blood vessels into the surrounding tissues. A healthy lymphatic system removes this excess fluid from the tissues and returns it to the bloodstream.

When the lymphatic system fails, protein can become trapped in the limbs. This trapped protein is what separates lymphedema from general leg swelling or edema. Lymphedema occurs when lymphatic drainage isn’t working properly, typically due to a blockage or inadequate pumping of the lymphatic system.

Lymphedema is often worse in one leg than the other, while edema involves more equal swelling on both sides. Diuretics aren’t typically effective for lymphedema because they remove water but not the trapped protein.

To address chronic leg swelling and lymphedema symptoms, it’s important to understand what’s interfering with the lymphatic system’s ability to pump and drain properly. Metabolic health is often linked to the severity of lymphedema.

This power is sent to the rear wheels only via a 6-speed manual, and it tips the scales at 1,533kg. All-in, the car is worth around £130,000.

Then we come to the BMW. Unlike the Viper, it’s had no mods added to it, which means its 5-litre V10 produces 507hp and 520Nm, with this power being sent to the rear wheels only via a 7-speed auto gearbox. It’s also the heavier car of the two, weighing in at 1,755kg. 

So the BMW is heavier, and it has less power - so does it really stand a chance?! There’s only one way to find out for sure… LET’S RACE!

videos.summary_source_text:
18.08.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

Key Features

• Auto Trading Engine
• Manual Trading
• Futures Trading
• Non-Custodial Infrastructure
• AI-Powered Trading Tools
• Copy Trading Features
• Educational Resources & Training
• Community Support
• Advanced Market Access
• Designed for Beginners and Experienced Traders

Jeff and Greg also dive into the rise of American-born goaltenders, why the United States continues to produce high-end talent in the crease, and what has gone wrong with Canada’s development pipeline as the country struggles to produce elite NHL goalies of its own. videos.title: Why Do My Legs Get Heavy Mid Shift?
videos.summary_source_text:
Why Do My Legs Get Heavy Mid Shift? The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body’s own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness.
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Try the push ball drill — keeping the arms straight and rotating your body through.
This teaches proper rotation, better extension, and that pure, ball-then-turf compression you see from great ball strikers.

videos.title: Anthropic’s AI Warning, Stripe’s $7B Rumor & Grok 4.6 Explained
videos.summary_source_text:
Anthropic’s AI Warning, Stripe’s $7B Rumor & Grok 4.6 Explained https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
Anthropic just raised its own AI risk warning. Stripe is reportedly considering a $7 billion OpenRouter acquisition. And xAI’s Grok 4.6 is challenging frontier AI models on something that may matter even more than raw intelligence: speed and cost.

In this video, we break down three major AI developments and separate what’s actually confirmed from what’s still rumor.

First, we look inside Anthropic’s latest Risk Report and why the company increased its misalignment risk classification despite saying the underlying evidence still supports a lower rating. We also examine the safety incidents and internal model details behind that decision.

Then there’s the reported $7 billion Stripe–OpenRouter deal. If it happens, Stripe could gain a powerful position in the infrastructure connecting developers, AI models, billing, and potentially the emerging AI agent economy. But neither Stripe nor OpenRouter has confirmed the reported acquisition, so the distinction between reporting and confirmed fact matters.

Finally, we look at xAI’s Grok 4.6 and its competition with models from Anthropic and OpenAI—not just on intelligence benchmarks, but on price, token usage, and speed.

Together, these stories point toward a much bigger shift: AI is becoming cheaper, faster, and increasingly autonomous while questions about safety, infrastructure, and who controls the underlying ecosystem remain unresolved.

Which concerns you more: gaps in AI safety systems, or a handful of companies potentially controlling the infrastructure AI agents depend on? Let me know in the comments.

GPT-5.6 vs Grok 4.6 (2026): Which AI Is Actually Better? https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
GPT-5.6 vs Grok 4.6 — which AI model is actually better?

Both OpenAI and xAI are pushing their latest models as major leaps toward more capable AI. But when you compare GPT-5.6 and Grok 4.6 across intelligence benchmarks, coding, reasoning, knowledge work, pricing, safety, and AGI claims, the answer gets much more complicated.

In this video, I break down the benchmark numbers behind GPT-5.6 vs Grok 4.6 and look at where each model actually wins.

GPT-5.6 has a major advantage in some real-world software engineering and terminal benchmarks. Grok 4.6, meanwhile, pulls ahead in several knowledge-heavy and long-horizon tasks — while also carrying a dramatically lower raw output-token price.

But there's an important catch: cheaper tokens don't necessarily mean your completed task will be five times cheaper.

And then there's the biggest question:

Are GPT-5.6 or Grok 4.6 actually getting close to AGI?

We look past the marketing and examine what these models can — and still can't — do.

If you're deciding which model to use for coding, research, AI agents, knowledge work, or your next AI product, this comparison should make the trade-offs much clearer.

Ända sedan jag köpte min C70 i Berlin har jag inte varit nöjd med körkänslan, insvängningen i kurvor, följsamheten. Och den har bullrat och känts lite för stötig, jag trodde att det har med sportdämparna att göra.

Vinn, vinn vinn.

videos.title: Fix Your Slice With the 9 & 3 O’Clock Check
videos.summary_source_text:
Fix Your Slice With the 9 & 3 O’Clock Check If you’re fighting a slice, check your clubface at 9 o’clock and 3 o’clock.
At 9 o’clock, you don’t want the face hanging wide open. Then as you swing through to 3 o’clock, let the club rotate naturally while the path works slightly out to the right.

A lot of golfers try to fix a slice by just swinging farther right, but if the face is still open, the ball is still going right.

Get the face and path working together and you can start turning that slice into a draw.
The Blue Brick makes this easy to practice because it gives you something to swing around. Set it down, let the club work through its natural arc, and miss the brick on the way through.

For the first exercise, place a resistance band, broomstick, or pole behind your head, pull your shoulders back, and slowly bend from side to side. This helps open the ribs and stretch the fascia across the front of the chest to support better posture.

Hindi - 17.08.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

videos.summary_source_text:
The Leapfrog Drill for Better Bunker Shots Bunker shots get a lot easier when you know exactly where the club needs to enter the sand.
Try this Leapfrog Drill next time you practice. Start by getting your weight forward, then focus on entering the sand a few inches behind the ball. Once you hit a good one, move to the next ball and repeat.
The goal isn’t to hit a bunch of perfect shots. It’s to get really comfortable controlling your low point and taking the right amount of sand.

Once you can do that consistently, bunker shots start to feel a whole lot less intimidating.
And if you want to make the shot even simpler, that’s where the BX-1 comes in. Its wide sole and beveled leading edge are designed to help the club move through the sand without digging as easily.

videos.title: From Beginner to All-Star, Rylie’s Transformation
videos.summary_source_text:
From Beginner to All-Star, Rylie’s Transformation The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

videos.title: Slice to Draw in ONE Lesson #golfswing #golftips
videos.summary_source_text:
Slice to Draw in ONE Lesson #golfswing #golftips John’s club was going under the plane in the backswing and over the top on the way down — leading to pulls and slices. While his path stayed consistent, his clubface wasn’t. The best fix? Learning to create a draw shape. We set up a simple alignment stick station: one along the target line, one behind him on the swing plane, and one through the target. His goal was to take it back over the plane and come under through impact.
This visual drill completely changed John’s clubface control — and helped him start hitting solid draws.

videos.title: Remaining NHL Free Agents, Patrik Laine & the Return of the Panthers | DFO Rundown
videos.summary_source_text:
Remaining NHL Free Agents, Patrik Laine & the Return of the Panthers | DFO Rundown Jason Gregor and Mike Rupp return for another Daily Faceoff Rundown, breaking down the biggest NHL offseason storylines with training camp just around the corner.

The guys take a look at the remaining NHL free agents looking for contracts, including Patrik Laine, Vladimir Tarasenko, Riley Smith, David Perron and Adam Henrique. Could Patrik Laine be a fit with the Tampa Bay Lightning, New York Islanders or Philadelphia Flyers? With his power-play ability still one of his biggest weapons, where is the best landing spot for the former 40-goal scorer?

They also examine the Anaheim Ducks' offseason and whether their blue line is good enough to make another playoff push after losing veteran defensemen Jacob Trouba and Radko Gudas. Could Logan Stanley be a fit for Anaheim as the Ducks look to add some size and experience on defense?

Plus, the guys discuss Connor Ingram and the remaining goaltenders available on the free-agent market, the new NHL preseason schedule and its impact on veterans and players fighting for roster spots, and why the shortened preseason could change the way teams approach training camp.

The Rundown also takes a look at NHL betting projections, including the Vancouver Canucks' 74.5-point total, the race to win the Eastern and Western Conferences, and Patrick Kane's projected goal total in his return to Chicago.

Finally, Gregor and Rupp discuss whether the Florida Panthers can bounce back after an injury-filled season, why the Edmonton Oilers should be one of the NHL's biggest regular-season bounce-back teams, and what to expect from the New Jersey Devils under new GM Sunny Mehta.

videos.title: Stop Trying to Hold Your Shaft Lean
videos.summary_source_text:
Stop Trying to Hold Your Shaft Lean If you’re trying to get more forward shaft lean, make sure you’re not holding it for too long.
You want the hands slightly ahead at impact, but from there the club still needs to release. If you keep dragging the handle through, it can make contact feel weak and inconsistent.

A simple feel is to think of a paintbrush: get it into position, then let it flick through.

The Blue Brick is a great way to work on this because it gives you a clear reference for where the club should be moving through the swing, instead of just trying to guess the position.

videos.summary_source_text:
The Easy Way To Hit Straighter Golf Shots - Every Club Want to learn how to hit straighter golf shots, including straight iron shots and straighter drives? This easy-to-follow golf swing drill works with every club in your bag and is one of the simplest ways to improve clubface control for more consistent ball striking and straighter golf shots.

Whether you're struggling with your driver, your irons or both, this practice drill can help you hit straighter iron shots and straighter drives without overhauling your entire golf swing.

In this golf lesson, Mark Crossfield demonstrates a practice station using nothing more than a spare golf tee to improve one of the biggest keys to better golf: clubface control.

By improving how the clubface behaves during your takeaway and follow-through, you'll find it much easier to start the ball on your intended line, reduce slices, hooks and inconsistent strikes, and build a more reliable golf swing.

The best part? This drill works with every club in the bag. Whether you're hitting driver, fairway woods, hybrids, long irons, short irons or wedges, the same principles apply to help you hit straighter golf shots more consistently.

If you're looking to improve your golf swing, hit the ball straighter, gain more consistency and lower your scores, give this drill a try and let us know in the comments how it works for you.

If you enjoyed this lesson, subscribe for more simple golf tips, golf swing drills and on-course coaching every week.

Here's what you'll learn in this lesson:

- How to improve clubface control using a simple golf tee and a practice station you can set up anywhere.
- Why your takeaway controls your golf swing long before you reach the top of the backswing.
- How to hit straighter golf shots by improving clubface awareness instead of making complicated swing changes.
- Why this drill works with every club, from driver through to your wedges.
- How to hit straighter drives and straighter iron shots without changing your entire swing.
- A simple way to practise at the driving range that gives instant feedback on your takeaway and release.

videos.summary_source_text:
New Audi E7X Review: 680hp for under £40k! Is the all-new Chinese Audi E7X better than the German Audi Q8?

Get 20% off Car Vertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

Mat’s got his hands on the all-new Audi E7X. 

However, this is no ordinary Audi! It’s been built exclusively for the Chinese market, so we won’t see it on sale in the UK, Europe or the USA! But why is that?

Audi is well aware that those looking to purchase a car in China are much more likely to buy something that is home-grown, rather than a German export. As a result, the E7X is a joint venture between Audi and SAIC, with Audi’s traditional four-ring logo dropped in favour of capitalised AUDI lettering instead. 

The question is, what else has changed? Let’s take a closer look… 

Starting with the design, although the size is relatively similar to an Audi Q8, there is almost nothing else that distinguishes it as an Audi. Whereas all German manufacturers' cars will follow some of the same design cues, if you were to remove the AUDI badging from the front and rear, you’d be hard-pressed to know what the brand was! Still, up front it looks modern and futuristic, with thin headlights and a wraparound loop design that features Matrix LED lights. Along the side, the similarity to the Q8 is more noticeable, although the surfaces of the panels are smooth (similar to an iX3), and around the back the design is relatively clean and similar in look & feel to the front end. 

Step inside, and it’s a similar story to the exterior - the design is totally different to what you would find in a German-built Audi. The main feature you’ll notice is a long screen that stretches across the entire dash, with a passenger screen also built into it. The infotainment system is relatively fast and easy to use, but thankfully, the climate controls are adjusted separately with physical buttons! Elsewhere, the cabin is covered in soft-touch materials, including an Alcantara-effect roof lining, and the seats are incredibly comfortable. 

For those in the back, there’s also a huge amount of space, with reclinable seats, leg rests, and a 27-inch retractable screen! There are also large, sturdy tables built into the back of each of the front seats.

The Audi E7X comes with two motors that combine to produce 680hp and 800Nm. So it’s no slouch, but then again, being electric, it tips the scales at a hefty 2,600kg. It comes with a 100kWh battery, which is good for a claimed range of around 400 miles.

The E7X is on sale in China at an incredibly low price, starting from just £36,360! That’s less than half the price of a similar-sized Audi Q8 from Germany. The question is, if this car were on sale in the UK, would you choose it over a Q8? Let us know in the comments!
